premise.dramatic_question: Will {HEROES} salvage what still matters from {THRESHOLD} before the closing horns seal it for good, and choose rightly what cannot all be saved?
resolution_space: the ledgers teach the crew what the index was really cataloguing, arming a better-prepared second pass
a page in the ledgers holds a copy of the index, carried home to puzzle over on their own time
closing time arrives mid-page and the keeper walks them out gently, with a promise to hold the ledgers
a level look at the crossing convinces them that this piece would cost more than it is worth tonight
one friend names the real risk aloud and the others agree without argument, calling the retreat the right call
a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate pull-back, and the pull-back reads as the sound decision
the wrong setting trips a safeguard built for exactly this shortcut, freezing the bench until the keeper resets it
the closing horns sound before the guess lands, and the fit must wait for another day
the strained mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to end the attempt for the night
the forced fit binds fast, and nothing the crew carries tonight will free it
a bent linkage needs a tool the bench clearly expects, and nobody brought one
the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and the crew honors it as part of the job
the workshop adopts the friends as its quiet caretakers, a role nobody assigned but everybody means
some unfinished piece in the room invites their hands, and finishing it becomes their standing task
the maker's notes name whoever finds the room its keeper, and the friends accept the appointment
the recovered piece is registered and shown by the settlement, the salvage's public record at last
the recovered piece quietly restores something the settlement had given up on, proof enough without a fuss
the recovery earns the keeper's open trust and a standing invitation back to the tower
a small promise made over the keepsake binds the friends as the ones who know what stayed behind
everything else goes back exactly as found and is logged honestly; the keepsake alone travels with them
the maker's letter asks its finders to choose what to keep quiet, and they choose the keepsake
the strongroom's true safeguard announces the overreach, and the keeper arrives before the door does
what they try to carry out past the limit is exactly what the safeguard was built to catch
second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to catch them mid-return, ledger in hand

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
first-person plural resolves: what we do next
question-forms at decisions, statements at continues
name the place or thing, let the action stay implied

facts.notice_posted: a clearance notice is posted: the tower will be sealed for renovation, and help is wanted before then
facts.crew_formed: the friends form an informal salvage crew; no one works the job alone
facts.job_undertaken: the friends commit to doing the actual work, not just reading the notice
facts.index_studied: the maker's coded parts-index has been read closely, in the tower's one indexing code
facts.priority_item_named: the index names one unfinished project as worth saving first, and a first lead on where to start
facts.own_way_found: the friends work out their own way past the building's weak points, unofficially
facts.keeper_enlisted: the outgoing keeper agrees to let the friends join the sanctioned clearance crew
facts.keeper_briefing_earned: the keeper, satisfied the friends mean to work, briefs them on the maker
facts.key_found: searching where the index points turns up a fitting tool, exactly as promised
facts.maker_history_known: the keeper's account of the maker's last years is understood
facts.past_the_door: the friends are inside the tower on their own steam, no escort needed
facts.salvage_underway: the salvage job is properly underway; the friends are past the door, working
facts.four_zones_known: four areas of the tower are known to hold scattered pieces: a climb, a study, a crossing, a cellar
facts.piece_recovered: a piece of the maker's unfinished mechanism has been recovered, from some zone or other
facts.archive_tempts: the study's ledgers pose their own quiet pull: catalogue them properly, or press on
facts.crossing_tests_nerve: the crossing is the tower's most exposed salvage run
facts.prize_glimpsed: a piece worth the risk waits at the crossing's far end
facts.at_the_bench: the friends stand at the maker's old assembly bench, where the pieces must be fitted
facts.assembly_live: the bench's own diagram shows plainly how the recovered piece fits, and that forcing it costs something
facts.assembly_jammed: forcing the fit jams the mechanism instead of completing it
facts.assembly_completed: the mechanism is properly assembled, on the bench's own terms
facts.second_index_found: a second, smaller index is found behind the bench
facts.strongroom_reached: the friends stand inside the strongroom the bench was guarding
facts.salvage_inventoried: what can be salvaged is seen and listed: the maker's letter, a keepsake, and modest settlement property
facts.carry_limit_understood: there is no time and no way to carry everything out before the horns seal the room; something must be left
facts.composure_kept: the friends leave with their composure intact; the outcome is a result, never a shaming
facts.salvage_can_resume: the salvage job can be picked up again; nothing about it is used up
facts.hidden_workshop_found: the maker's living workshop is found past the second index
facts.caretaker_role_earned: the friends earn an ongoing caretaking role over what they found
facts.crew_bond_formed: the shared job forges a lasting trust between the friends
facts.salvage_registered: the friends register the recovered piece with the settlement's public collection
facts.maker_intent_understood: the maker's reason for leaving the piece unfinished is understood
facts.salvage_kept_private: the friends keep the small keepsake among themselves, and log everything else honestly
facts.ledger_corrected: whatever was taken is put back and entered honestly in the keeper's ledger
facts.keeper_catches_them: the keeper turns up at the moment of temptation, whether the friends meant to be caught or not

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: brisk purpose with mild time pressure and real fondness for the work; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one indexing code per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from the notice to the bench to the back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the index's named lead and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per salvage zone, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough logic that any single zone makes the bench attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each zone distinct and worth salvaging beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the strongroom holds more than can be carried out; contents are knowledge, heritage, and wonder, any treasure modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or a piece, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden workshop feel currently alive rather than preserved

affect.target: brisk purpose, the pull of a job worth doing

cipher_form.note: the story's one indexing code; every later cataloguing beat renders it consistently

n_inside.merge_note: NC-1: six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive carrying different leads, tools, or company. Presuppose only the intersection every route guarantees: the notice exists and the crew has committed to the work. Do NOT reference how they got in, which opening they used, or whether the keeper is present. Write the arrival generically: the crew is inside, the actual salvage work starts now.

n_clockface.merge_note: NC-1: four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied piece_recovered from a DIFFERENT zone. Presuppose piece_recovered generically: the crew has something to fit, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose which zone was cleared, any specific object carried, or any room's device.
